question: Compare the configured lost-link actions of the Matrice 30T, Matrice 4T, and EVO Max 4N.

intake.decided_by: code (single pass has no intake call)

brief.short_answer: FAA guidance supports initiating emergency or contingency procedures for loss of control link when reestablishment fails. DJI/Matrice 30T and 4T manuals describe configurable signal-loss actions (RTH, hover, land) and automatic triggers (RTH on loss, low battery, etc.). Autel EVO Max 4N likewise lists Signal Lost behavior options (Return to Home, Hover, Land) with configurable Signal Loss Action. Incident reports show real-world occurrences of lost-link with RTH or failure to regain control, sometimes under interference. Key gaps include whether actions auto-execute vs. require user input and whether RTH paths are consistent across models under differing GNSS/vision system conditions.

claims.text: FAA guidance indicates to start emergency or contingency procedures for loss of control link if reestablishment fails.
claims.quote: If connection cannot be reestablished, start emergency or contingency procedures for loss of control link.

claims.text: DJI Matrice 30T: When remote controller signal is lost, action can be set to RTH, land, or hover; RTH path shown if lighting/vision system suitable; RTH may continue if signal returns.
claims.quote: The action of the aircraft when the remote controller signal is lost can be set to RTH, land, or hover in Camera View > > > Signal Lost Action in DJI Pilot 2.

claims.text: DJI Matrice 30T: Failsafe RTH is triggered on loss of signal if configured; RTH behavior described including potential ATTI mode and landing during failsafe RTH.
claims.quote: Loss of remote controller signal When the remote controller signal is lost, the aircraft will automatically initiate Failsafe RTH if the Signal Lost Action is set to RTH.

claims.text: Autel EVO Max 4N: Signal Lost behavior options include Return to Home, Hover, and Land; Signal Loss Action options include Continue mission and Auto RTH; reconnection logic described.
claims.quote: The drone’s Signal Lost behavior options include Return to Home, Hover, and Land. Signal Loss Action options include Continue mission and Auto RTH.

claims.text: Autel EVO Max 4N: Reconnection attempts and consequences described; if link restored within 10 seconds control returns; if not, Signal Loss Action executed.
claims.quote: If the link is restored within 10 seconds after disconnection, control will automatically return to the remote controller. If reconnection is not established within 10 seconds, the Autel Enterprise App will display the warning message “Aircraft disconnected,” and the drone will execute the preset Signal Loss Action or Signal Lost behavior accordingly.

claims.text: Incident (Matrice 30T): Lost-link with RTH within 10 seconds observed; interference near antenna noted as potential cause.
claims.quote: Lost link and RTH occurred twice on back-to-back hops. After securing flights; the crew noticed a cellular antenna booster within 6 feet of the pilot in command; used by the command vehicle data terminal (non-uas). Repeated testing shows interference with the flight controller within 5 feet of the antenna.

claims.text: Incident (Matrice 30T): Another report describes loss of control with limited control and attempted RTH, with subsequent regain of control and landing.
claims.quote: I was operating a DJI M30T and had just taken off at a beach location when at around 25' AGL the drone decided to take off vertically and I lost all control of the drone. The sticks were unresponsive... I proceeded to toggle on and off... the drone responded and I landed.

sections.label: DJI Matrice 4T incident reports
sections.abstain_reason: no claims in the single-pass brief

claims.text: Incident (Autel EVO Max 4N): Shortfall in control after takeoff with complete loss of control and unrecovered drone; all attempts to Return To Home failed.
claims.quote: Shortly after takeoff I completely lost control of the UAS. Platform continued to fly away from me while input into the controls to return. All attempts of Return To Home features failed.

gaps.text: No consolidated model-wide summary of each platform’s exact default Signal Lost Action and whether RTH is mandatory vs. optional in all loss-link scenarios.
Differences in whether RTH path is auto-updated after link restoration across models.
FAA guidance emphasizes risk management with preflight procedures; manufacturer manuals emphasize in-flight action options which may override per-flight risk assessment.
Lack of verified cross-model equivalence for GNSS/vision-system dependence during RTH under low light.
Limited verified incident data tying specific signal loss actions to model outcomes.
No explicit citation for Matrice 4T exact default Signal Lost Action depending on lighting conditions.
